newsitem.title: ITALY: IFIL sees 1997 results better than '96-MD.
newsitem.headline: IFIL sees 1997 results better than '96-MD.

text.p: Italian industrial holding company IFIL's 1997 results will be better that in 1996, managing director Gabriele Galateri told the annual shareholders' meeting.
The Agnelli family holding company posted consolidated net profit of 339 billion lire in 1996 against 321 billion in 1995.

"Considering the good performance of our main subsidiaries and the positive effect of certain recently announced operations, it is reasonable to think that 1997 results can improve further on those of 1996," Galateri said.
IFIL recently linked up with French family-owned hypermarket chain Auchan and sold off a stake in chemical company Unicem.
The AGM was also told that a possible merger between IFIL and the Agnelli family's holding IFI was not on the cards.
Umberto Agnelli, chairman of IFIL and vice chairman of IFI, said such a project "is not being studied."
